    At Home With:  Drew
    Michael
    Scott of Lone
    Fox

    Nestled in L.A., designer and YouTube star Drew Michel Scott's 1920s Spanish colonial is the current font of his creative wanderings. Inside, each room tells the story of his favorite sources of inspiration, from storied antiques to modern Brutalist influences. We visited Drew to see how these elements played out in his debut Joon Loloi collaboration—and how he styled it at home.

    Drew is the creator behind Lone Fox, a brand encompassing all things home and design—from an interiors and DIY-driven YouTube channel followed by millions, to the online shop Drew curates personally.

    A Layered Lobby

    Here, earth tones, natural textures, and organic elements rule, creating a warm, serene feel—the definition of storied. The Holmby Rug ties the room together, while the Benedict, Laughlin, and Hepburn Pillows add a dash of old-Hollywood charm.

    Bold Lines in  the
    Living Room

    The living room captures the spirit of Drew’s 1920s Spanish Colonial—all romance and Baroque-inspired elements. To complement that style, he chose the contemporary-classic Olvera Rug, which was inspired by vintage tiles found around his home.

    A Picture - Perfect Office

    Organic warmth is the vibe of Drew's office: The Fairfax Rug grounds the space in softness and a tonal checkerboard pattern.

    Drew’s Tailored Bedroom

    Inspired by menswear patterns, Drew dressed his bedroom in plaids and striped patterns, choosing the Arlington Rug and the Kerr Pillow to add complementary designs and texture to the space.

    A Serene Second
    Bedroom

    Where modernity meets romance: Marie’s bedroom embraces softness and organic elements, layering on the textures and neutral hues. The Runyon Rug provides a warm foundation while the Hepburn Pillow adds a pop of color.

    A Dining Room That Transports

    Antique charm abounds: Drew chose the Doheny Rug for the dining room, complementing the dark-colored woods and antique-inspired elements of the space.

    A Moody  Movie
    Room

    Depth and dimension rule the movie room, dressed up with antique-inspired flourishes and a dark palette. The Kinney Rug and Kerr and Turner Pillows add dimension—and plenty of texture—with their varying striped designs.

    In the Kitchen

    The Reseda Rug complements the rich color palette of the kitchen with its storied design, adding depth to the space with its traditionally inspired motif.
